Before After
Flat Roofing

Flat Roof Replaced

The old felt roof beside the house had split and rotted through. We stripped it back, boarded it and covered it in a new rubber membrane.

Before After
Roof Repairs

Missing Roof Sheets Replaced

Several sheets were missing from this corrugated roof, leaving it open to the weather. New sheets were fitted in the gaps so it keeps the rain out again.

Drag the slider to compare the before and after.

Before After
Guttering

Blocked Gutter Cleared

Moss from the roof had filled this gutter. We cleared it out so rainwater runs away from the house again.

Drag the slider to compare the before and after.

New Roofs

Detached House Re-Roofed

Scaffold went up round the house and the old roof came off, then it was felted, battened and finished in new dark tiles. The two photos are the same house from different sides.
